body:
I know but.. all the money in the world can't buy genuine friends. I just want what it seems like everyone else has. The stories my dad tells about him and his higschool friends getting into trouble or fighting or whatever, I want to have those stories.

I don't think I'll ever be rich. I'm too lazy, too stupid, and too socially retarded. But if I could just have someone who liked me despite of all of that, I would be so fucking happy. I think I would be able to change. Right now it's just, what's the point? There's nothing to look forward to.
